criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Query General Information
categories.definition: Asking for facts, definitions, calculations, advice, or general knowledge.

categories.name: Query Current Status
categories.definition: Asking for dynamic, time-sensitive, or personalized information such as time, date, weather, personal schedule, or account status.

categories.name: Query News
categories.definition: Requesting current news headlines, articles, or updates on specific topics.

categories.name: Control Smart Device
categories.definition: Activating, deactivating, or adjusting settings of smart home devices, appliances, or system settings like volume or screen brightness.

categories.name: Manage Calendar/Reminders/Alarms
categories.definition: Creating, modifying, deleting, or viewing calendar events, reminders, or alarms.

categories.name: Manage Lists
categories.definition: Creating, adding items to, removing items from, or deleting shopping lists, to-do lists, or other personal lists.

categories.name: Communicate
categories.definition: Sending emails, making calls, or posting on social media.

categories.name: Manage Contacts
categories.definition: Adding, editing, or querying contact information.

categories.name: Play Media
categories.definition: Playing music, podcasts, audiobooks, or videos; controlling playback, or requesting media recommendations.

categories.name: Book Travel/Order Ride
categories.definition: Booking tickets for travel or requesting a ride service.

categories.name: Find Recipe/Cooking Instructions
categories.definition: Requesting recipes or instructions for cooking.

categories.name: Open Application/File
categories.definition: Opening a specific application, folder, or file.

categories.name: Navigation
categories.definition: Requesting directions, finding points of interest, or querying location-based information.

categories.name: Order Food/Services
categories.definition: Ordering food, drinks, or other specific services, or querying service availability.

categories.name: Conversational/Miscellaneous
categories.definition: Utterances that are greetings, expressions, statements, or too vague to categorize as a specific command.
